correctness.rationale: XOR-translation reduces any shattered six-set to six weight-two vectors; distance identity proves a center realizing a nonempty trace has weight 0, 2, or 4, hence at most four outside-support positions matter. Small d cases and star witnesses checked with exact executable; reduction, not finite extrapolation, proves the theorem.
